quotes.text: Most people have heard that the endocannabinoid system helps with sleep, mood and pain. What almost nobody mentions is that it also talks to estrogen, all day, in both directions. So when estrogen starts to swing, that whole conversation changes, and you feel it at three in the morning.

quotes.speaker: Dr. Saffi Velloquin
quotes.text: Anandamide is the molecule I call the quiet cheerleader. When estrogen is up, it tends to be up too, and the world feels a little softer. In perimenopause that rhythm gets noisy. Some months there is plenty, some months there is almost none, and nobody tells you why your mood followed it.
quotes.heading: The Bliss Molecule You’re Running Low On
